title: Brutalist Courtyard, Noon
prompt: A brutalist concrete courtyard at noon with deep window recesses, a shallow reflecting pool and a lone tree. The camera cranes up the facade as hard shadows carve the geometry.
description: How to build real-scale brutalist architecture from batched bevelled boxes with layered concrete weathering, lit by a hard small-angle noon sun over a disc-less physical sky, shot with a crane move.

brief.prompt: A brutalist concrete courtyard at noon with deep window recesses, a shallow reflecting pool and a lone tree. The camera cranes up the facade as hard shadows carve the geometry.

tags.lighting: hard noon sun, deep geometric shadows

techniques: batched axis-aligned boxes into one mesh per material with a per-face tone attribute
kit.textured board-formed concrete scan with node-layered tone, rain streaks and damp
kit.sun with small angle plus kit.sky(sun_disc=False) as skylight fill
kit.dolly as a crane: rising camera with a rising look target
recursive bmesh tree with thousands of leaf cards for dappled shadow
transmissive water box over a dark slate basin for reflections
kit.haze at very low density for aerial depth
